description: This is a shell script used for testing the behavior of 'git ls-files' with exclude options and gitignore configurations. It defines test cases to verify the correct listing of files under different scenarios in a git repository.

methods.name: check_output
methods.description: Function to verify the output of 'git ls-files' with specific options against expected results.

methods.name: check_all_output
methods.description: Function to run 'check_output' for different exclude scenarios to ensure correctness.
